answer: Operator-Linked Reputation Escrow. Each wallet’s trust score is an anchor tied to its operator’s revealed identity via a signed enrollment record. Any cluster of wallets flagged as coordinated resets the operator’s escrow, freezing all their wallets for a voyage of 90 days. To rejoin, the operator pays a fresh escrow per wallet plus a flat penalty, and loses accrued standing in every orchard they farmed. Sybils thus cost per-identity cash and shared reputation, not just wallet dust.
